items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Evan mentioned that, Evan Christopher, that you don't play with an amp.

ctx.x: Yeah. Totally. And when you go on a tour with a band and you go out for three weeks or a couple of months, man, yeah, you can see the difference by the end of the tour. It’s really tight.
I think Evan mentioned that, Evan Christopher, that you don’t play with an amp.
